ruleDefinitions.name: Potential ShellDispatch.DLL Functionality Abuse
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential "ShellDispatch.dll" functionality abuse to execute arbitrary binaries via "ShellExecute"

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "RUNDLL32\.EXE") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*RunDll\\_ShellExecuteW.*"))
